methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series A → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.0x) to $335M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Chips & Semiconductors (found 1 same-stage, 1 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 12 same-sector peers exist in Chips & Semiconductors, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

methods.name: Public-Comp Anchoring
methods.skip_reason: target revenue not on file (private companies rarely disclose)
methods.rationale: Public Semiconductors P/S median is 21.0x across 3 tickers. Cannot apply without target's revenue.

private.name: SambaNova Systems
private.rationale: Same sector (Chips & Semiconductors), same stage (Series A), post-money $11B

data.narrative:
Ricursive Intelligence, a Series A-stage semiconductor company founded by Anna Goldie and Azalia Mirhoseini, has raised $335M to date. The valuation assessment draws on a comparable universe of 3 public semiconductor firms (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) and 8 private peers including SambaNova Systems, Cerebras, and Credo Semiconductor.

Given the absence of disclosed revenue and an insufficient narrow peer dataset (only 1-2 same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables), the peer-median and public-comp anchoring methods are inapplicable. The stage-progression method is therefore the sole quantifiable anchor, applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement to the $335M total raised proxy, yielding $670M. A sensitivity range accounting for downside and upside scenarios yields a low of $570M and a high of $770M.

The analysis supports a median valuation of $670M, with a plausible range of $570M–$770M. Key uncertainties include the absence of revenue visibility, limited direct peer comparables at this stage and capital scale, and the sector's dependence on technical inflection and adoption timelines. The stage-progression result should be stress-tested against actual fundraising terms and the company's progress on hardware and software milestones before final valuation assignment.
